rustenv.CARGO_PKG_DESCRIPTION: A copy of the core::slice::sort module from the Rust 1.56.1 standard library, modified to behave the same on 32-bit platforms as on 64-bit. This is intended to work around a determinism bug in the halo2_proofs crate.
